verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal has a first-party API Reference with per-endpoint pages (e.g. /api-reference/Call-Log/readUserCallLog) and a "Your first API call" guide, so the reference itself exists. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable "try it" examples. missing for 10: evidence of in-browser runnable or try-it requests, interactive request/response examples, an exposed OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
